story:
Pinnacle Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. was established in 1993 in Nanticoke, Pennsylvania. Thirty-three years later we are still a commercial roofing contractor and nothing else — flat and low-slope membrane, architectural metal, and the sheet metal that ties a roof together at its edges. That focus is deliberate. The details that decide whether a commercial roof lasts fifteen years or five are not the same details that matter on a house, and we have never wanted to be a company that does a little of both.

Growth in commercial construction around Scranton eventually made a second facility necessary, so we opened the Dickson City location under John Racht. Between the two offices we cover Luzerne, Lackawanna and Monroe counties, and we keep on-call service technicians at both so an active leak gets a real response rather than a place in a queue.

The work speaks for itself better than we can. Since 1993 Pinnacle has roofed Geisinger Medical Center in Danville, Geisinger CMC in Scranton, Geisinger South and Geisinger Wyoming Valley, Sanofi Pasteur in Swiftwater, the Tobyhanna Army Depot, Kalahari Resort at Pocono Manor, Wilkes University, Penn State Worthington, Luzerne County Community College, the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton International Airport and Procter & Gamble in Mehoopany — among a good many others across Northeastern Pennsylvania. We have earned an Excalibur Award, given to the top roofing contractors in the United States, every year since 1994, and we hold a Gold Medal Contractor Quality Award. We are members of the Northeastern Pennsylvania Contractors Association, the National Roofing Contractors Association, and the Wilkes-Barre, Scranton and Hazleton Chambers of Commerce.
